records.text: A December 2024 court petition challenged the last will, testament, and trust of 95-year-old Alton C. Jennings after he had begun showing signs of cognitive decline in 2020.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: In December of 2024, a court petition was filed challenging the last will and testament and trust of a man named Alton C. Jennings. Okay. Alton died at 95 years old in a very long life. Per the lawsuit, these are still just allegations. Per the lawsuit, Alton began showing signs of cognitive decline in 2020.

verification.notes: The transcript explicitly frames this as a lawsuit allegation. A report based on the petition states that a declaratory-judgment petition was filed December 14, 2024 challenging Alton C. Jennings's will and trust; it reports his death at 95 and the petition's allegation that cognitive decline began in 2020.

sources.title: Turning Point USA and Young America's Foundation In Legal Battle Over A Dead Grandfather's Will
sources.relevance: Reports the filing date, challenged estate instruments, age, and petition's cognitive-decline allegation from the court filing.

records.text: Jennings's grandson alleged in the December 2024 estate petition that caretaker Mitchell Manley Sr. isolated Jennings from friends and family and seized control of his finances.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep ZZGWo6oDscc)

appearances.snippet: It was lawsuit he the grandson alleges that thereafter, Mitch Manley Sr. isolated his declining grandfather from his friends, from his family, and he seized control of his finances.

verification.notes: This anonymous-source statement represents allegations in Jennings's grandson's petition, not adjudicated facts. The court-filing report says the petition accuses caregiver Mitchell Manley Sr. of isolating Jennings from family and taking control of his finances after being hired around 2021.

sources.title: Turning Point USA and Young America's Foundation In Legal Battle Over A Dead Grandfather's Will
sources.relevance: Confirms that the isolation and financial-control assertions appear as allegations in the petition.

records.text: The December 2024 estate petition said that four months before Jennings died, a November 2023 will amendment made Turning Point Action one of the beneficiaries of an estate valued around 5 million.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep ZZGWo6oDscc)

appearances.snippet: when the elderly man died less than three years later at the age of 95. The family discovered that he had changed his will. He changed his will in November of 2023. So for clarity, just four months before this man died at the age of 95, he moved to change his will. You'll never guess who he decided to leave his estate to, the estate which was valued at $25 million. He left it, split it amongst turning point action, headed up by none other than Tyler Boyer.

verification.notes: The source based on the court petition reports that Jennings died March 29, 2024; an eighth amendment dated November 6, 2023 added Turning Point Action and YAF among beneficiaries; their share included half the residual estate valued around USD 25 million. Thus the statement accurately summarizes the contested petition, not a final merits ruling.
